column1: # Image repository -> upstream source -> SPDX license, for the airgap bundle SBOM.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the bundle redistributes ~100 container images. A normal
# install pulls them from their own registries, which is not redistribution; the
# bundle hands them over as one tarball, which is. That flips the licensing
# question from "what do we depend on" to "what are we distributing, and under
# what terms" — and the answer is not uniformly Apache-2.0.
# NOT GUESSED. Every row was resolved from the upstream repository's own license
# via `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/license`; the handful GitHub cannot classify
# were read out of the upstream LICENSE/COPYING file and carry a note. Guessing a
# license here would be worse than leaving it blank, because a wrong SPDX id in an
# SBOM is repeated downstream as fact.
# (re-resolves every row from upstream; overrides below are preserved by hand)
# TERMS THAT ARE NOT "just Apache-2.0" — the reason to read this file:
#   AGPL-3.0    grafana, loki, loki-canary, tempo. Network use counts as
#               distribution: users interacting over a network must be offered
#               the source. Redistributing the bundle makes that your obligation.
#   (RSALv2/SSPLv1 — REMOVED, kept here as a decision record)
#               ArgoCD's upstream install.yaml pins redis 8.x, which is tri-licensed
#               RSALv2 / SSPLv1 / AGPLv3; the first two are source-available, NOT OSI
#               open source, and RSALv2 forbids offering the software as a managed
#               service to third parties. 13-argocd.sh now repoints argocd-redis at
#               valkey (BSD-3-Clause), so no such image reaches the bundle. If a row
#               for public.ecr.aws/docker/library/redis reappears here, that swap
#               regressed — fix the swap, do not add the row.
#   MPL-2.0     openbao, vault-k8s. File-level copyleft: modified files stay MPL.
#   GPL-2.0     busybox, frr. Source-offer obligation on distribution.

column4: per-file SPDX; predominantly GPL-2.0-or-later, some LGPL/BSD
